//: Type-check configuration for the test runtime (shared library, fixtures and both test tiers).
`tsx` transpiles WITHOUT checking, so this is the only thing in the repo that checks types.
`generated/` is excluded: it holds compiler output (the Manager, the k=20 reference oracle and
the two test-support Minters), which is produced by scripts/compile.sh and never committed.
The one generated `.d.ts` the tests DO need is pulled in explicitly by simulation/tsconfig.json.
`noUncheckedIndexedAccess` was tried and turned off again: it produced 63 findings, every one of
them array destructuring or a Record lookup that is provably present, and zero bugs.
